translations.web: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.
translations.bsb: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and the length of his life was 147 years.
translations.kjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
